Package com.nexuslink.plugin

Interface ResourceExplorer

All Known Implementing Classes:
AzureBlobExplorer, FtpExplorer, GcsExplorer, JdbcExplorer, KafkaExplorer, MongoExplorer, RedisExplorer, S3Explorer, SftpExplorer
public interface ResourceExplorer
Browses the live object hierarchy of a connected resource. Implementations wrap a connected protocol service (JDBC, Mongo, Kafka, MQ, …) and answer lazily so large trees stay responsive.

The UI calls roots() once a connection is established, then children(com.nexuslink.plugin.ResourceNode) on demand as the user expands nodes. All methods may perform I/O and are invoked off the UI thread.
